say:1:1330331001:1.text: I was told that a guest left through the back door and ran into a beast.
say:1:1330331001:1.source_cn: 听说是有位游客从旅店后门离开，结果遇见了野兽。
say:1:1330331001:1.male: I was told that a guest left through the back door and ran into a beast.
say:1:1330331001:1.female: I was told that a guest left through the back door and ran into a beast.

say:2:1330331002:1.text: We'd already warned our guests that it wasn't safe outside before they checked in. It's beyond me why they still wander around.
say:2:1330331002:1.source_cn: 在入住前，我们提醒过客人旅店外面并不安全，也不知道客人...
